page.layout: One page: digitiser's cover sheet. Logo at top right, title block centred, a rule, boxed usage notes, a rule, further usage notes, and a logo at bottom right.
page.notes: Digitiser's cover sheet from e-rara.ch, not part of the printed book. Its title block reads: "Archetypi homiliarum in in acta apostolorum per D. Lucam descripta", Gwalther, Rudolf, Tiguri, 1607, Zentralbibliothek Zürich, Shelf Mark 12.454. Also includes usage notices in German, English, French and Italian, and the Visual Library logo. Left out as digitiser material.
